scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

controls.hit_counts: |mean z| <= .10 and var z in [.85, 1.15] pooled; Monte Carlo chi-square p >= .05 on pooled counts
controls.clustering: per-program gap variance inside its simulated 5-95 band for >= 90 percent of programs
controls.length_independence: slope of mean fraction_hit on n inside its 2000-permutation band
controls.reproducibility: equal keys give equal masks for every program (3 keys)
controls.sham: displacement 0 and reward equal for every program

disposition_rule: INSTRUMENT_QUALIFIED iff every control passes; else INSTRUMENT_FAILURE (rereads stop)

provenance.normalisation: loss = D2/D3 share over draws (binary); dreward = absolute reward_per_ask change
provenance.denominator: draws (4) per cell; programs paired with themselves
provenance.alters_baseline_function: no: the baseline is the undamaged program; the sham path verifies the route
